publication.title: SemFacet: Faceted search over ontology enhanced knowledge graphs
publication.version: ISWC2016poster/demo author version; distinct fromJ.WebSemantics37journal report

source_reading.scope: All main sections/workflow, architecture, configuration, Yago demonstration andreferences.

adjudication.basis: SemFacet extends its implemented ontology-aware RDF faceted search with keyword indexing, additionalreasoners andincremental/minimized facet updates. It queries actualYago data andpresents results as annotated snippets; thisdemo doesnot introduce a newuser study.

descriptions.interaction: Enter keywords, select/unselect facets, refocus the result set and inspect annotation/image snippets. Conjunctive versus disjunctive choices and hierarchies can be configured.
descriptions.guidance: Data/ontology-derived meaningful facets hide choices producing empty or unchanged answers; incremental options and result updates support refinement.
